"...Above all, slow down and welcome every detour.
Let yourself be pleasantly distracted. Treat it as a true vacation, in every sense.
Don’t hurry past a single tree or stream.
Pause wherever the moment calls and linger in the sun..."

Lass Dich ablenken. Mach sozusagen Urlaub.

Dear guests, here you find our availability and booking calendar.
Frequently Asked Questions
Where is Schloss Moosburg located?
Schloss Moosburg sits on a hill west of the village of Moosburg in Carinthia, about 15 minutes by car from Klagenfurt and 10 minutes from Lake Wörthersee. The address is Schloss 1, 9062 Moosburg, Austria.
How old is Schloss Moosburg?
The first documented mention dates back to the year 861. The castle has been owned by the Goëss family since 1708.
How many rooms does the guesthouse have?
Gästehaus Schloss Moosburg offers 17 double rooms, each individually furnished in the historic ambience of the castle.
Is breakfast included?
Yes, a generous breakfast with regional products is included in the room rate.
Is there parking at the castle?
Yes, free parking is available directly at the castle.
Is there a secure storage for bicycles and eBikes?
Yes, a lockable garage for bicycles and eBikes is available at the castle, including charging facilities for eBike batteries. This makes Schloss Moosburg an ideal base for cycling tours around Lake Wörthersee and the Carinthian lake district.
Are pets allowed?
For reasons of hygiene in our rooms and garden, pets cannot be accommodated. Thank you for your understanding.
How can I book?
We recommend booking directly via our website — this is usually more affordable than booking portals, as no commission fees apply. Alternatively you can reach us by phone at +43 664 88676122 or by email at office@schloss-moosburg.at.
What sights are nearby?
Nearby you'll find Lake Wörthersee, Klagenfurt with its old town and dragon fountain, the Pyramidenkogel as the world's tallest wooden observation tower, as well as numerous hiking trails and Carinthian lakes.
The castle and its terraces form a true hortus conclusus – an intimate, hidden sanctuary where peace, deep relaxation, and unhurried enjoyment unfold in complete privacy, reserved exclusively for hotel guests.
Die wunderschöne Schlosswiese
At the very top of the old tower, hidden from view and filled with tranquil silence, our Sri Lankan housekeeper, Mr. Sampath, offers deeply relaxing and wonderfully revitalising Ayurvedic treatments by prior arrangement.
On a gentle hill west of the village of the same name near Pörtschach am Wörthersee rises a Gothic castle that has been in the possession of the Counts of Goëss since 1708. Its origins reach back to the year 861, making it one of the oldest continuously inhabited buildings in Austria and a cherished cultural monument of Carinthia.
The castle nestles in a unique natural landscape in the heart of Carinthia, framed by deep forests and idyllic fishing and bathing ponds. Seventeen lovingly furnished double rooms invite guests to linger and unwind. The Gothic Knights’ Hall, magnificent stucco ceilings and carefully preserved historic interiors create an authentic atmosphere in which the spirit of its origins can be felt in every room and every detail.
We would be very happy to receive a review from you!

Our Rooms :: schloss-moosburg.at
The Rooms
Guests are welcomed into a charming historic setting, thoughtfully combined with all the comforts and amenities of modern sleeping culture for a relaxing stay.
The castle offers 16 inviting guest rooms and a cozy garden suite in the south wing, each with its own special character and unique atmosphere. Extra beds for children are available on request to accommodate families.
Amenities
Antique furniture, paintings, graphics, shower or bathtub, wooden or parquet flooring, free internet access, allergy-friendly, wardrobe, heating, seating area, hairdryer, bathroom, separate toilet in most rooms, safe.
